exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: a passive FET translator; SDLS966M line 600 says pull-up resistors are always required on the high side, so it cannot drive the connector high against the 10 kΩ pull-down; EN is tied to Vref_B through 200 kΩ, not driven from the enable node
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: Neither stated ground holds as written, but the drop stands on others. SDLS966M (revised May 2023, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/lsf0108.pdf, read 2026-09-28T18:00:46Z), section 8.3.2, lines 520-525: 'the EN pin must be LOW' for high impedance, and EN 'is recommended to be disabled by an open-drain driver without a pullup resistor'. EN can therefore follow the enable node through an open-drain stage. A high-side pull-up strong enough to beat the 10 kΩ pull-down does drive the line high. What fails is this. (1) That required pull-up holds the connector high while the RP2354B pad is released in reset, against the low of V73. (2) Table 9-2 requires Vref_B ≥ Vref_A + 0.8 V, and Vref_A must be the lowest level on any I/O. A 3.3 V RP2354B side and a 3.3 V connector level (V63) cannot meet both.

exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: a 2:1 multiplexer with one select (SEL) and one active-low EN for all 4 channels (SCDS391), so one element cannot switch per port; SEL and EN leakage is stated only with VDD powered
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The first clause is not a requirement. The gate enables every line together from the enable node, so one common active-low EN (through the enable inverter) serves the 4 ports. That is how P2's rank 2, SN74CBTLV3125, and the 244 are used. With SEL tied, the part is a 4-channel switch, and tOFF(EN) is 95 ns max, under 1 µs. The drop still stands on the second clause. SCDS391C (revised December 2019, https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tmux1574.pdf, read 2026-09-28T17:48:35Z) gives the logic IIH and IIL (±2 µA) with VDD powered, plus an internal 6 MΩ pull-down. It gives IPOFF (±2 µA) for the I/O pins only. Section 8.3.5, Fail-Safe Logic, is a voltage tolerance. So no current limit is stated on EN at VDD = 0 V.
